text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; fill: rgb(34, 36, 42);
text.tspan: Correction creates a superseding version. The prior version and linked
verification remain visible evidence marked not current / revalidation required.
The corrected version is sent to both Aggregator and Verifier for fresh validation.

rect.style: fill: none; stroke-opacity: 0; stroke: white; stroke-width: 15px;
stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: none; stroke-width: 2px; fill: none;

path.style: fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: rgb(34, 36, 42); stroke-width: 2px;

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; fill: rgb(34, 36, 42);
text.tspan: The contribution may itself be consolidated from multiple
contributors. The Verifier validates the contribution or artifact and
its evidence, including traceability and applicable rules, not the
Aggregator's work, method, or performance. A corrected version
requires fresh validation; prior verification remains linked as not

rect.style: fill: none; stroke-opacity: 0; stroke: white; stroke-width: 15px;
stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: none; stroke-width: 2px; fill: none;

path.style: fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: rgb(34, 36, 42); stroke-width: 2px;

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; fill: rgb(34, 36, 42);
text.tspan: Each version carries its Contribution ID, version, Observation
Key, governed standard and policy versions, provenance,
evidence, and any corrects or replaces reference. One simple
sender event fans out through two declared point-to-point

rect.style: fill: none; stroke-opacity: 0; stroke: white; stroke-width: 15px;
stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: none; stroke-width: 2px; fill: none;

path.style: fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke: rgb(34, 36, 42); stroke-width: 2px;

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; fill: rgb(34, 36, 42);
text.tspan: Matching uses the named versioned exact or semantic
Matching Policy. Mismatch, ambiguity, stale validation, or
another relevant issue takes the correction route. Only
current versions with fresh validation may be used.

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; fill: rgb(34, 36, 42);
text.tspan: Normalize matched current versions under the named
Information Standard and Aggregation Policy, apply
governed calculation and confidence rules, and preserve
traceability in the consolidated artifact and its evidence.
